## Welcome

Hi, I'm Matthew — an undergraduate researcher and systems practitioner splitting my time between IT systems engineering, data science, and hands-on RF/embedded electronics. This site collects the projects, and occasional field notes, that come out of that mix. Read more [about me](about.qmd), or dig into what I've been building below.

## Featured Highlights

* **[QRP CW Transceiver: From Toroids to On-Air Telemetry](projects/qcx-mini.qmd)** — Assembling a discrete-component RF transceiver kit from scratch, hand-building a matching antenna, and confronting the physical realities of RF design.
* **[Robotics: Retrofitting the BoE Bot for AI](projects/BoE.qmd)** — Exploration of robotics fundamentals and embedded Linux for turbocharging experiments with the BoE educational chassis.
* **[Morse Code: A Data Science Perspective](projects/cw-data-sci.qmd)** — A semester-long project leveraging Data Science principles (ETL) and Literate Programming techniques to construct a DSP pipeline for analyzing CW.
* **[Common Lisp: Algorithmic Sudoku Solver](projects/cl-sudoku.qmd)** — Is Common Lisp all McCarthy hoped it'd be? Is Common Lisp "the perfect language for an AI world?" These core questions spurred me to investigate this unique language.
